title: Root cause surfaced by the shard-threshold simulation: the containing section is appended as OPERATIVE text

mechanism.what: 'Neighborhood guarantee': for EXCEPTION / BASKET / PROVISO / CONDITION roles the containing section node is pushed onto structuralNodeIds / structuralNodeKeys as a LINK ('what does this exception modify').
operativeSourceText = structuralNodeIds.map(id => index.getNodeText(id, 'DESCENDANTS')).join('\n\n') - every linked node, including the whole parent section, becomes operative text.
resolveSourceContext presents the joined text as ONE contiguous OPERATIVE region anchored at the first node (7.2(k) is reported as abs 50,520-60,141 although the node spans 50,520-51,296).
only the anchor node's subtree is recognised as units; the appended parent text collapses into one residue NODE_OWN_TEXT unit ('<ref>~2') that no threshold can split (atomic; oversized at 4,000).

shardedAt12000.single: 17/70 (cross-reference expansion regions, each its own shard)

focusCasesDecomposition.note: every 'long' focus case is a short provision followed by the identical 8,843-char section 7.2, which itself contains the provision again (true duplication inside the operative text).

frozenPilotRun_0731_262records.note: the real compile path DID take the SHARDED branch at the default 12,000 budget for 147/262 records; the previous mission's 'runs MONOLITHIC below 12,000' statement was a character comparison, not a planner run, and is corrected here.

dsgr.method: largest physical occurrence per nodeKey - upper bound

falseCreditControls.reading: chapeau / lead-in text of 9 control sections is duplicated verbatim into 93 exception/basket/condition candidates' OPERATIVE text - a chapeau rule can be emitted (and credited) from any of those child candidates. No shard threshold changes this; the candidate-span contract does.

classification: CANDIDATE_SPAN_CONTRACT_MISMATCH (discovery linkage consumed as operative span) - PRODUCTION defect at orchestrator.ts:418, reproduced identically by the pilot harness; NOT a sharding-threshold problem.
